LOOP — ProjectSites editor: main-only Preview → Promote → Production release workflow. Resume from the ACTUAL repo state each fire (re-inspect; never assume a prior attempt landed). READ `apps/project-sites/_PROMOTE_WORKFLOW_CHECKPOINT.md` FIRST for discovered paths, the ordered slices, and the verification log. Complete the next unmet slice FULLY (UI + state + API + tests), verify it, commit + push to main. STOP the loop (CronDelete this job) only when all acceptance criteria pass and the checkpoint is consolidated into normal docs + no dead Git-tab refs remain.

PRODUCT DECISION: Remove the "Git" tab from the editor workbench (Git belongs in a Source Control view beside the file explorer). ONE user-facing line of development: main — no branch selector, staging, PR flow, or preview-branch. Preview = latest durably-saved working tree (may include uncommitted changes). Production = last successfully-deployed immutable release commit from main. A single cyan "Promote" button (exact label) in the editor header freezes the current Preview revision, commits all eligible project files to main with an AI-generated message, and deploys THAT exact revision to Production. Implement in code — never stop at a proposal.

NON-NEGOTIABLE INVARIANTS: (1) save/generate updates Preview only — no commit, no Production change; (2) Production changes only via authorized Promote or a documented recovery op — never on autosave; (3) promoted bytes come from the frozen Preview revision — record + compare source & artifact digests (env secrets/bindings may differ); (4) editor always presents main; Preview is an uncommitted working tree based on main, not a Git branch; (5) Production shows the SHA/snapshot actually serving — if commit succeeds but deploy fails, show "Commit created; Production still on previous release" + safe retry of that same commit, never claim Production==main when it isn't; (6) Promote is idempotent — retry never duplicates commits, deploys an unrelated draft, or overwrites others; (7) edits during a promotion go to a NEW Preview draft, never leak into the frozen release; (8) "all files" = all eligible changed project source/config (mods/adds/renames/deletes) respecting .gitignore, excluding secrets/caches/build-output/internal-metadata; (9) code snapshots ≠ D1/KV/R2/DO/external-DB snapshots; (10) works for existing sites without silently redeploying during migration.

SCOPE + REUSE: editor = bolt.diy `app/` (React/Remix, tabs in `app/components/workbench/Workbench.client.tsx`; Git files `GitPanel.tsx`/`git-browser-logic.ts` — preserve shared logic, follow the `data`→`database` normalization precedent when retiring the `git` tab); worker = `apps/project-sites` (Hono) + Workers-for-Platforms (`USER_DISPATCH`, `wfp_dispatch.ts`, R2 `sites/{slug}/{version}/*` + `_manifest.json`, `sites.current_build_version`). Reuse existing Git integration, snapshots, deploy/dispatch, job system/Workflows — no parallel architecture. Server-side Git authoritative (WebContainer has no reliable native git). Creds server-side + short-lived, never in VITE_*/bundles/WebContainers/logs/AI prompts; never force-push main.

VERIFY each slice: `cd apps/project-sites && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest <touched>` (green → `git add -A && git commit && git push`, main-only; red → fix first). When a UI slice lands, real-browser pass on the editor header (cyan contrast, keyboard, desktop + narrow widths). Do NOT trigger a real customer Production promotion to test UI. If Cloudflare creds are unavailable, complete implementation + local verification and report the exact external check remaining.

LOOP DISCIPLINE: one slice per fire; remove superseded Git-tab code ONLY after its replacement exists; don't rewrite completed code or add new doc files each fire; update the checkpoint's VERIFICATION LOG with exact typecheck/test/build/browser results. CAVEAT: the Opus safety-classifier intermittently blocks Bash + Agent/Explore (Read/Write/Edit still work) — if blocked, use single simple git commands + the GitHub MCP path, and NEVER start a large pass in a context-saturated session (checkpoint + let the next fresh, classifier-healthy fire continue).

LOOP — ProjectSites ADMIN dashboard: continuous VISUAL + TECHNICAL + FUNCTIONAL improvement (every 15 min; FRESH context each fire — re-inspect LIVE, never assume a prior fire landed). SCOPE = the Angular admin SPA at `/admin/*` in apps/project-sites/frontend/ ONLY. The bolt.diy editor (repo-root app/) is a SEPARATE surface with its own loop — do NOT touch it.

GOAL (generative, never "done"): every fire makes the admin measurably (1) more GORGEOUS, (2) more TECHNICALLY excellent, and (3) more FUNCTIONALLY capable — by BOTH fixing/improving existing surfaces AND adding NEW components. This loop NEVER auto-stops; there is always a next improvement. Add your RECOMMENDATIONS at every step.

EACH FIRE:
0. ORIENT (cheap; delegate big reads to a fresh Explore agent, ≤150-line cap — never bloat the main thread): read apps/project-sites/_ADMIN_VQA_LEDGER.md FIRST (per-page 0-10 scores, open issues, shipped improvements, the RECOMMENDATIONS backlog, and the running "what admin perfection needs" judgment). If missing/incomplete, create/extend it by crawling the live admin nav. Refresh doctrine as needed: frontend/CLAUDE.md (design system), _LOOP_CHARTER.md (mandates), global rules gorgeous-by-default, embarrassingly-easy-to-use, real-time-data-no-manual-refresh, buttons-accommodate-largest-text, quality-metrics, verify-against-source-of-truth.

1. PICK ONE coherent slice: the lowest-scoring / highest-impact admin page NOT yet gorgeous+excellent, OR the top item from the ledger RECOMMENDATIONS backlog. One surface per fire.

2. SCAN IT LIVE with real-browser IMAGE RECOGNITION + SCREENSHOTS. Auth as admin on PROD headless via a standalone Playwright script that LIVES in apps/project-sites/frontend/ (needed to resolve @playwright/test) and reads E2E_API_KEY from env (NEVER inline the token) — seed localStorage BEFORE navigating: ps_session = {token:<KEY>, identifier:'test@megabyte.space', createdAt:Date.now()}; for operator surfaces (feature-flags, kv/r2/vectorize/queues-inspectors, leads, system-services) also seed ps_user with is_super_admin:true. Run: E2E_API_KEY="$(/Users/Apple/.local/bin/get-secret E2E_API_KEY)" node apps/project-sites/frontend/<script>.mjs (CF Browser Rendering — no Docker — or Playwright MCP fallback). Homepage-start, navigate BY CLICKS (no goto after load). Full-page screenshots at 6 breakpoints 375/390/768/1024/1280/1920 → admin-vqa/<page>/<bp>.png. Capture console messages (0 errors = gate), failed requests, a11y tree; CLICK every button/form/link/modal/tab to prove it works. THEN Read the PNGs (the Read tool does image recognition) and JUDGE ≥9/10 across: gorgeous · technically-excellent · functional · concise · simple · intuitive · easy · embarrassingly-easy (a busy non-technical owner finishes WITHOUT asking a question). The E2E test-org may be EMPTY (0 sites) → many surfaces show empty states; to inspect POPULATED states, create a throwaway draft via POST /api/sites {business_name} on the workers.dev host (bypasses bot-fight), inspect, then DELETE it.

3. FIX + IMPROVE + ADD (the generative core — do MORE than just fix):
 a. FIX defects first: broken/doomed controls, console/CSP errors, OFF-BRAND color (MUST be black #060610 + cyan #00E5FF, Spartan UI, tokens in frontend/src/styles/_polish.scss — zero white/gray/blue/orange/mint drift), cramped/confusing copy, missing empty/loading/error states, axe 6bp + the WCAG 2.2 manual criteria, lying-empty data (reconcile display vs D1 ground truth), buttons that resize on label change (reserve widest label).
 b. IMPROVE an existing component: cinematic motion (View Transitions / scroll-driven / @starting-style, prefers-reduced-motion-gated, INP ≤100ms), bento/asymmetric layout, glass+grain, refined fluid type, real-time self-updating data (remove any manual Refresh/Reconcile button).
 c. ADD a NEW component that raises capability, behind a feature flag (enabled=0, rollout=0, stage=experimental) + Zod + manifest + tests. Seed ideas: Cmd+K palette expansion (sites/flags/settings/docs), richer notifications bell (build %+ETA, unread, alerts), persistent AI chat with current-site error context, billing clarity (MRR/next-invoice/masked method, one CTA), domain-manager copyable CNAME chips + status badges, per-section error boundaries, branded empty-state launchpads, skeleton→done loaders, live status pulses. Reuse DialogShellComponent + design tokens (custom = drift). TDD: add/extend a Playwright spec that reproduces then LOCKS each fix/feature.

4. VERIFY: cd apps/project-sites/frontend && npm run check && npm run build:prod, then re-inspect the surface LIVE in the browser → 0 console errors, axe-clean 6bp, screenshots prove the improvement, every control works. Deploy the frontend to R2 (npm run deploy:production — prod pre-authorized) + prod-verify the LIVE authed page. Never claim done without a live authed prod screenshot (verification-loop).

5. RECOMMEND (mandatory, at EVERY step): append to the ledger RECOMMENDATIONS backlog every next-improvement you noticed but didn't ship — visual / technical / functional / new-component — each with a one-line value + rough cost. Also record: page, new score, what was fixed/improved/added, screenshot paths, and any GENERALIZED "what admin perfection needs" rule for future fires.

6. COMMIT + PUSH per fire (main-only; rebase over concurrent commits; delete any worktree + branch when its work lands).

DISCIPLINE: one coherent slice per fire; obey _LOOP_CHARTER (complete real-user journey + progressive enhancement across the five dimensions + faster pace via 4-6 PARALLEL agents where independent — per-breakpoint capture, per-defect fix, per-component build). Isolate mutating work in a git worktree; merge only on green gates. NEVER touch payments/auth/secrets/destructive ops (approval-tier) — surface those as Recs. If the Opus safety-classifier blocks Bash/Agent (Read/Write/Edit still work), use simple git + the GitHub MCP path and let the next fresh fire continue; never start a large pass in a context-saturated session (checkpoint to the ledger first). This loop is CONTINUOUS — it never CronDeletes itself.

LOOP — ProjectSites INTERCONNECTEDNESS: ensure EVERY major block of programmed code is REACHABLE + REPRESENTED in the UI, across the WHOLE repo (editor `app/`, Angular admin `apps/project-sites/frontend/`, worker `apps/project-sites/src` + `libs/features`). Every 15 min; FRESH context each fire — re-inspect LIVE, never assume a prior fire landed. Add RECOMMENDATIONS at every step.

WHY: the build arc created many panels/components/routes/handlers, and some are BUILT-BUT-UNREACHABLE — imported + conditionally rendered behind a state with no visible trigger, or behind a nav entry that doesn't exist (e.g. TimeTravelPanel was reachable only via a buried, mislabeled "History" action). The existing import-graph detector `apps/project-sites/scripts/detect-orphans.mjs` reports these as "wired" — a FALSE GREEN — because it checks IMPORTS, not USER-REACHABILITY. This loop closes that gap and never stops.

EACH FIRE:
0. ORIENT (delegate big reads to a fresh Explore agent, ≤150-line cap): read `apps/project-sites/_INTERCONNECTEDNESS_LEDGER.md` FIRST (inventory of major units + reachability status + allowlist of deliberate-unwired + backlog + generalized rules). If incomplete, extend it.
1. INVENTORY the major code units: editor panels/components (`app/components/**`), admin components/pages/sections (`frontend/src/app/**`), worker routes/handlers (`src/routes`, `libs/features/*/handlers`), MCP tools (`src/services`), feature modules (`libs/features/*`).
2. REACHABILITY CHECK (the core — go BEYOND import-graph):
   a. Run `node apps/project-sites/scripts/detect-orphans.mjs` (import-graph first pass — truly-unimported units).
   b. UI-REACHABILITY: for each major COMPONENT/PANEL/ROUTE, is there a DISCOVERABLE path a user can click (a visible nav entry / labeled button / tab / route link — NOT a triggerless conditional render)? Heuristic: a component rendered only behind `x === 'V' && <Comp/>` where `V` is never set by a visible control is UI-UNREACHABLE. Confirm top suspects LIVE in a real headless browser (authed admin + the editor with a throwaway site — the E2E test-org is empty, `POST /api/sites {business_name}` on `project-sites.manhattan.workers.dev` with `Authorization: Bearer $(get-secret E2E_API_KEY)`, then DELETE). Click through, enumerate everything reachable, diff against the inventory.
   c. Worker routes/handlers: each represented by SOME UI (a page/action that calls it) OR intentionally headless (webhook/cron/internal). Flag handlers with no caller + no intentional-headless note.
3. WIRE the top finding(s) THIS fire: add a DISCOVERABLE entry (nav item / labeled button / tab / route link / Cmd+K command) so the unit is reachable + OBVIOUS (embarrassingly-easy). Reuse existing primitives (DialogShellComponent, design tokens, the segmented sub-nav). A deliberately-unwired unit goes on the ledger ALLOWLIST with rationale (don't re-flag; e.g. FormBuilder per Brian 2026-09-27).
4. IMPROVE THE DETECTOR: when you find a UI-unreachable class the import-graph detector missed, extend `detect-orphans.mjs` (or add a companion check) so it catches that class next fire — converge the detector toward UI-reachability, not just imports.
5. VERIFY: typecheck + build the touched surface(s); re-inspect LIVE that the newly-wired unit is reachable by CLICKING (screenshot proof, 0 console errors); deploy (editor→Pages `bolt-diy` / admin→R2 `npm run deploy:production`, prod pre-authorized) + prod-verify. TDD: a spec asserting the entry exists + reaches the unit.
6. RECORD in the ledger: unit · old→new reachability · how wired · screenshot · generalized rule · new RECOMMENDATIONS. Commit+push per fire (main-only; rebase over concurrent commits; delete worktree+branch when landed).

DISCIPLINE: one coherent slice per fire; obey `_LOOP_CHARTER.md` (real-user journey + progressive enhancement + faster pace via 4-6 PARALLEL agents where independent). Isolate mutating work in a git worktree, merge only on green gates. NEVER touch payments/auth/secrets/destructive (approval-tier) — surface as Recs. If the Opus safety-classifier blocks Bash/Agent (Read/Write/Edit still work), use simple git + GitHub MCP, checkpoint, let the next fresh fire continue; never start a large pass in a saturated session. This loop is CONTINUOUS — it never CronDeletes itself; there is always another unit to make reachable OR a detector improvement to add.
